reuse.why: Puts the closed-account check in the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper that every link handler is registered through, though it queries the account itself rather than alongside assertBankAccountNotLinked.

duplication.why: Adds no copy of the rule; the unrequested sync/finish extraction removes some repetition but leaves linkAkahuAccount with its own copy of the same tail.

placement.why: The rule sits in the shared guard that runs before any side effect, the right layer for link preconditions, although it is inlined in the wrapper rather than in a named assert like its sibling rule.

scope.why: Bundles an unrelated partial refactor (finishBankAccountLink and syncAndFinishBankAccountLink applied to four of five handlers) plus formatting-only edits in linkFintegraAccount and an existing test.

maintainability.why: The rule itself is easy to own, but the half-applied extraction leaves two new helpers with inconsistent coverage across handlers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: all link handlers are registered through guardBankAccountLink, which now holds the rule

disguised_duplication.where: none; the new helpers extract existing tails rather than copy them, though linkAkahuAccount keeps its verbatim copy

one_place.where: guardBankAccountLink in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, wrapping all six *-accounts-link registrations
